name: vibey
description: Drive vibey and a local gpt-oss model from your editor. Runs on your own computer; no account and no cloud.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Ask the local model to do something in this folder. It works on a copy, so nothing changes until you choose Apply.
[Ask gpt-oss](command:vibey.ask)
[Run a folder of tasks](command:vibey.runBatch)

commands.title: Ask gpt-oss to do a task
Apply a finished run to my branch

view/title.when: view == vibey.model || view == vibey.projects || view == vibey.gates || view == vibey.runs

vibey.cliPath.markdownDescription: The `vibey` program to run. Empty: the first `vibey` on your PATH. **Vibey: Check my setup** prints the one it found and its version.

vibey.qwenloopPath.markdownDescription: The `qwenloop` program that runs a task on the local model. Empty: the first `qwenloop` on your PATH.

vibey.ollamaPath.markdownDescription: The `ollama` program, used only to start a server with `ollama serve` and to show a download command. Empty: the first `ollama` on your PATH.

vibey.gitPath.markdownDescription: The `git` program. Empty: the first `git` on your PATH.

vibey.ollamaUrl.markdownDescription: Where Ollama listens, in root form without `/v1`. Empty: `$VIBEY_OLLAMA_URL`, else `http://127.0.0.1:11434`.

vibey.ollamaAppPath.markdownDescription: macOS only: the Ollama app **Start Ollama** opens when it exists. Otherwise `ollama serve` is started.

vibey.model.markdownDescription: The model tasks run on. Empty: `$VIBEY_OLLAMA_MODEL`, else `gpt-oss:20b`.

vibey.maxTurns.markdownDescription: The most model turns one task may take (`qwenloop run --max-turns`). `0`: qwenloop's own setting, else 40.

vibey.effort.markdownDescription: Passed to `qwenloop run --effort`. qwenloop 0.2.0 accepts the flag and does not use it yet.

vibey.contextWindow.markdownDescription: The context window, in tokens, qwenloop assumes (its own `context_window`, default 32768). **Check my setup** warns when Ollama loaded the model with a smaller one, because Ollama then drops the start of long tasks without saying so.

vibey.runInPlace.markdownDescription: Run tasks directly in the open folder instead of in a separate copy (a git worktree on its own branch). **Off is safer**: with it on, the model edits your files as it goes and there is no Apply or Discard.

vibey.baseRef.markdownDescription: The git branch or commit a task's copy starts from. Empty: whatever you have checked out (`HEAD`).

vibey.stormHome.markdownDescription: Where task copies, plans and records are kept. Empty: `$VIBEY_STORM_HOME`, else `~/git/vibey-storm` on macOS and `$XDG_DATA_HOME/vibey/storm` (or `~/.local/share/vibey/storm`) on Linux. A folder your computer empties at restart is refused (sub-doctrine 10.h).

vibey.modelLockPath.markdownDescription: A lock directory that keeps runs on the same computer from sharing the model at once, including runs started from a terminal with `vibey-vscode`. Empty: `.ollama-lock` in the storm home.

vibey.maxConcurrentRuns.markdownDescription: How many tasks may use one model at the same time. Further tasks wait in line. `1` is the measured best on a 24 GB Mac: at two, answers drifted from what one run gives (structural fidelity 0.82, under the 0.95 floor; #1114, sub-doctrine 8.c).

vibey.refreshSeconds.markdownDescription: How often the Model, Projects and Gates views refresh themselves.

vibey.pollMilliseconds.markdownDescription: How often a running task's event log is read for new lines.

vibey.stuckHintMinutes.markdownDescription: After this many minutes without a new event, a running task shows a hint. Nothing is ever stopped for being slow: on a 24 GB Mac one turn of gpt-oss:20b took 16.5 s typically and 112.6 s at the 95th percentile.

vibey.desktopNotifications.markdownDescription: Let qwenloop send its own desktop notification at every turn. Off: the editor shows progress instead.

vibey.environment.allow.markdownDescription: Extra environment variables (a name, or a prefix ending in `*`) passed to qwenloop and the commands the model runs. vibey's own variables (`VIBEY_*`), PostgreSQL's (`PG*`) and anything named like a database credential are never passed, whatever this says.
